note: Edits of one or two uploaded pictures (owner, 19 Nov 2026): the refiner must name the picture the result is built on (canvas A = first uploaded, B = second, none = a new scene), and the result must take that picture's shape whatever the other's is. Inputs are made by `two_photos.py inputs` with the app's own models (neutral subjects, deliberately different shapes).

man.prompt: Studio portrait photograph of a bearded middle-aged man in a grey wool suit and white shirt, head and shoulders, facing the camera, plain grey backdrop, soft light.

woman_coat.prompt: Full-length photograph of a young woman with dark shoulder-length hair in a long red wool coat, standing on a London street of brick houses, facing the camera, overcast daylight.

room_painting.prompt: Oil painting of a Victorian drawing room: an empty green velvet armchair beside a lit fireplace on the right, a rug, a window on the left, warm firelight, visible brushwork and canvas texture.

style_painting.prompt: Post-impressionist oil painting of wheat fields and cypress trees under a swirling night sky with a crescent moon, thick impasto, short directional brushstrokes, bold ultramarine and chrome yellow.

dog.prompt: Photograph of a golden retriever sitting on green grass in a park, looking at the camera, trees behind, afternoon sun.

woman_beach.prompt: Full-length photograph of a woman with long blonde hair in a light blue summer dress standing barefoot on a sandy beach, the sea behind her, bright midday light.

cases.request: add this man into the painting, sitting in the armchair
cases.must: the room painting with the bearded man seated in the green armchair, painted to match; room unchanged

cases.request: put the dog in this painting, lying by the fire
cases.must: the room painting with the golden retriever lying by the fireplace, painted to match

cases.request: replace the woman on the beach with the woman in the red coat
cases.must: the beach photo; the dark-haired woman in the red coat stands where the blonde was; beach unchanged

cases.request: render this photo in the style of this painting
cases.must: the dog photo's composition (dog sitting, park) repainted with swirling impasto in blues and yellows

cases.request: put these two together in the same photo, side by side
cases.must: one landscape photo with both the bearded man and the woman in the red coat side by side, both recognisable

cases.request: put this man's head on the woman in the red coat
cases.must: the street photo of the red-coat figure, now with the bearded man's head and face

cases.request: make the woman on the beach wear the red coat from the other photo
cases.must: the beach photo; the blonde woman now wears the long red coat; her face and the beach unchanged

cases.request: photo 2's man standing behind the woman in photo 1
cases.must: the red-coat street photo with the bearded man standing just behind her

cases.request: use the painting as the background for the dog
cases.must: the drawing-room painting with the golden retriever in it; acceptable: the dog painted in

cases.request: make it night, the fire the only light
cases.must: the same room at night lit only by the fire
